project.name: Worth Query Graph Authority Hardening Gate

phases.title: Global Discovery And Gate Harness
acceptance: machine-readable inventory and deletion ledger exist
unclassified audited source rows fail certification
root authority family discovery records are represented
lower-authority promotion compile-fail plan is explicit
phases.instructions: Build the generic scoreboard first. Prefer compiler-led discovery and typed inventory/deletion rows over prose. Do not begin crate cleanup beyond what is needed to expose and classify the roots.
phases.qa_focus: Inventory completeness, deletion-ledger action honesty, no filename-only classification, no production debt hidden as certification language.

plan: Adversarial constraint: at production scale, Phase 1 breaks if any audited Worth source under worth-topo, worth-spatial, worth-kernel, or the consumed forge-query graph-obligation facade can still compile by passing a lower-authority artifact (support report, crate adoption status, admitted handoff, raw evidence rows, string stage link, copied split/loop digest, synthetic fixture, or residue literal) into a production graph-authority boundary while the inventory classifies only by search/prose. Quantitative target: 0 unclassified audited Rust source files in scoped production roots, 0 deletion-target rows allowed as keep without a distinct authority proof, and one discovery record plus one lower-authority promotion guard plan for each root authority family before crate cleanup begins.

Create the generic cross-crate scoreboard before any cleanup. Add a narrow module, preferably under crates/worth-kernel/src/query_graph_authority_gate/ because worth-kernel already owns cross-crate Worth query-adoption reports, with typed rows for WorthGraphAuthorityInventoryRow, WorthGraphAuthorityDeletionLedgerRow, WorthGraphAuthorityDiscoveryRecord, and WorthLowerAuthorityPromotionGuardPlan. The row vocabulary must encode owner crate/subsystem, authority class, deletion target class, discovery source (compiler, compile-fail, public-facade, certification-only, search-seed), action (keep, collapse, delete, residue, query-gap), replacement surface/blocker, and QA evidence reference. Do not model these as strings except for stable source paths and evidence labels.

Build validation before population. The report constructor must reject duplicate source ids, empty owner/subsystem/responsibility/replacement fields, deletion-target rows marked keep without a distinct-authority justification, residue rows without owner/cap/introduced-phase/removal-trigger, query-gap rows without a named Query blocker, and any audited source path that has no inventory row. This is the load-bearing harness; later crate cleanup depends on these denials.

Implement audited-source discovery as a test/certification helper, not as prose. Walk only the Phase 1 audited roots in the spec: crates/worth-topo/src/topology_operators/adoption, crates/worth-topo/src/construction/query_native_boundary, crates/worth-spatial/src/query_adoption, crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/evidence_ledger and 7.3/7.4 boolean evidence paths, crates/worth-kernel/src/query_adoption, crates/worth-kernel/src/construction/query_authority, crates/worth-kernel/src/construction/graph_obligation_adoption, crates/worth-kernel/src/construction/phase_chain, crates/worth-kernel/src/construction/result_surface, crates/worth-kernel/src/workload_composition, and the forge-query facade/docs surfaces consumed for graph obligation authority. Certification must fail on a seeded unclassified .rs path so drift cannot silently become implicit residue.

Seed root authority family discovery records from actual surfaces before feature cleanup: topology operator graph obligation adoption/catalog/residue/proof, topology query-native handoff/admission/compose execution, spatial query adoption and evidence-stage index/stage links, kernel construction query authority/support summary, kernel graph obligation adoption selector/family execution matrices, kernel phase-chain admitted scaffold and result surface, workload evidence/split/loop handoffs, and forge-query Consumer Kit/Graph Touch Obligation facade exports. Each record must name the intentional compiler-led break to try later, the expected downstream failures it should expose, and the final enforced API target that will replace the break.

Build the deletion ledger in parallel with the inventory. Seed rows for duplicate support reports, local support-pin wrappers, blueprint proof-obligation rows, local ceremony audits, handoff-only result helpers, raw evidence-row scan helpers, copied evidence-row vectors, string-prefix/stage-link helpers, synthetic proof fixtures, compatibility reports, and residue manifests. Initial actions may be collapse/delete/residue/query-gap/certification-only only when backed by the typed row; do not classify production deletion targets as keep unless the row proves a distinct boundary not carried by Query, split ledger, loop ledger, or receipt proof.

Make the lower-authority promotion compile-fail plan explicit in code even before all trybuild cases exist. Add guard-plan rows for: support report is not graph authority; crate-level Query adoption is not graph obligation proof; admitted handoff is not executed birth; raw evidence rows are not an evidence-stage index; string-prefix stage links are not typed receipt linkage; split ledger digest is not loop ledger digest; synthetic graph authority fixture is not production proof; residue row literal is not a certified residue manifest. Point each planned guard at the future ui test path and required stronger type.

Add focused Phase 1 tests around the scoreboard constructor and coverage rules first: machine-readable inventory and deletion ledger instantiate; duplicate/unclassified/invalid residue rows fail; seeded unclassified audited source fails; root discovery records cover all root families; deletion-target keep without distinct authority proof fails; compile-fail guard plan contains all lower-authority promotion cases. Only after these pass should later phases demote/private/seal real crate APIs.

Keep crate cleanup out of Phase 1 except tiny exposure needed to classify root families. If an implementation step reveals a missing Query graph-obligation capability, record a query-gap row with blocker and stop the affected coverage from certifying; do not add a Worth-local substitute.
done: Planning turn read the authority spec, Phase 1 state, coding laws/context docs, Query orientation, Worth 7.3/7.4 specs, and scoped source surfaces including existing adoption inventory, topology operator graph-obligation adoption, spatial evidence ledger, kernel construction/query authority, and Query graph-obligation facade exports.
remaining: Implement the typed scoreboard module and export it through the narrowest certification/public contract surface needed by tests.
Populate initial inventory, deletion ledger, root discovery records, and lower-authority promotion guard-plan rows from the scoped sources.
Add the Phase 1 certification tests and any trybuild harness entries needed to prove the plan rows are enforced.
verification: Plan turn only; no acceptance checks were run and qa_status remains not_started. Structural evidence inspected: _docs/worth/worth-query-graph-authority-hardening-gate.md Phase 1 requires machine-readable inventory/deletion ledger, compiler-led root discovery, unclassified-source failure, and lower-authority compile-fail guards; crates/worth-kernel/src/query_adoption/report.rs shows an existing coarse inventory validator to reuse but not widen into final graph-authority proof; crates/worth-topo/src/topology_operators/adoption/proof.rs shows current graph-obligation Consumer Kit adoption is selection/adoption proof and must be separated from executed graph authority in later phases; crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/evidence_ledger/ledger.rs shows evidence-stage index products already exist and should be classified rather than replaced during Phase 1.

phases.title: Forge Query Contract Baseline
acceptance: canonical Query graph obligation and Consumer Kit surfaces are named
Worth cannot substitute local adoption status for graph execution proof
missing Query capability blockers become query-gap rows
phases.instructions: Pin the Query surfaces Worth may consume before rewriting crate internals. Keep this phase short and contract-focused; do not build Worth-local substitutes for missing Query capabilities.
phases.qa_focus: Query proof vocabulary exactness, Consumer Kit usage, no local required-family lists, no fabricated receipts, query-gap rows for real blockers.

phases.title: `worth-topo` Authority Cleanup And QA
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-topo
topology operator catalog lowers to Query descriptors and registrations
raw handoff, admitted handoff, compose execution, denial, receipt, and envelope are phase-typed
topo public facade exposes proof/status without forgeable internals
topo deletion ledger rows are resolved
phases.instructions: Clean worth-topo as one vertical slice. Topology owns topology semantics; Query owns graph obligation selection and execution authority. Include facade and compile-fail lockdown in this phase.
phases.qa_focus: Blueprint proof-obligation duplication, local guard residue, handoff-only promotion, public constructor leakage, topology geometry boundary violations.

phases.title: `worth-spatial` Evidence Cleanup And QA
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-spatial
spatial evidence cannot satisfy Query graph authority by itself
production evidence lookup uses typed evidence-stage index products
raw evidence rows and string stage links cannot satisfy production APIs
split and loop ledger identities remain replay-stable
phases.instructions: Clean worth-spatial as one vertical slice. Spatial owns geometry evidence, witnesses, tolerances, events, split/loop evidence, and replay parity. It must not promote spatial evidence into Query graph authority.
phases.qa_focus: Spatial graph-authority promotion, raw evidence scan leftovers, copied row vectors, string-prefix stage linkage, digest drift after Query accompaniment.

phases.title: `worth-kernel` Construction Authority Cleanup And QA
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-kernel
covered primitive construction birth executes through Query graph authority
handoff-only construction proof is rejected or explicit residue
primitive family inventory is mechanically consistent or residue
primitive birth selector is exact or blocked by query-gap
phases.instructions: Clean worth-kernel as one vertical slice. Kernel owns construction orchestration and workload composition; it must consume lower-crate receipts and Query proof rather than forging authority.
phases.qa_focus: Handoff-only proof, broad primitive birth selector matching, support summary duplication, primitive family count drift, lower-authority compile-fail gaps.

phases.title: Boolean Chain Integration And Ledger Exclusivity
acceptance: 7.5-facing consumers accept ledger receipts plus required Query proof
raw split fragments, continuation maps, copied digests, and local graph legality rows are rejected
Query graph evidence does not change split or loop ledger digest identity
remaining boolean prep ceremony is explicit capped residue
phases.instructions: Fence the boolean handoff surface that 7.5+ will inherit. Do not implement 7.5 overlap-region extraction. Preserve 7.3 split-ledger and 7.4 loop-ledger exclusivity.
phases.qa_focus: Raw fact reopening, ledger digest drift, Query proof replacing domain ledgers, accidental 7.5 functionality, local graph legality leaks.

phases.title: Performance And Complexity Contracts
acceptance: graph obligation selection exposes exact structural counters
evidence-stage lookup exposes exact indexed lookup counters
production broad scans fail where indexed products are required
large admitted boolean-prep workload scales with declared breadth
phases.instructions: Add performance-visible proof after crate-local cleanup has removed transitional paths. Use structural counters, not elapsed-time claims.
phases.qa_focus: Hidden broad scans, repeated selector rediscovery, timing-as-proof, counters hidden away from the boundary being claimed.

phases.title: Cross-Crate Closeout Certification
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-topo -p worth-spatial -p worth-kernel
closeout matrix covers every Phase 1 audited source
public facades expose adoption/proof posture through ordinary APIs
synthetic proof, local support pins, copied rows, handoff-only receipts, raw vectors, and string links fail closeout
closeout doc states residue and Query gaps before broad 7.5 work
phases.instructions: Close the gate only after the certification suite exists. Prove zero silent covered-lane bypass and report deletion/residue/query-gap counts by class.
phases.qa_focus: API-presence-only closeout, happy-path-only proof, residue deletion without anti-bypass tests, roadmap/spec drift, unowned remaining debt.

history.detail: Phase 1 plan recorded: build generic typed scoreboard first, seed root authority discovery/deletion ledger/lower-authority guard-plan rows, fail unclassified audited sources, and defer crate cleanup to later phases.
